summary: Full E2E backend + Expo web preview verification for SIH1440 Rescue Coordination. Backend: 12/12 pytest cases green (health, announcements, tasks-with-lat/lng, inventory, POST+GET verification for SOS/messages/resources/missing/incidents, PATCH task accept, 404 handling, no Mongo _id leak). Frontend on 375x667: role picker -> survivor home (sos-button, sos-active-card with GPS fallback 28.6139,77.209 works), quick-resources form saves (resource-saved), quick-missing form with name/photo/use-gps/submit works without crash, TacticalMap renders with SOS + task pins for both roles, announcements feed loads seeded content, chat send appends bubble and reaches backend (icon-based delivered indicator, no text), status/availability segments persist via AsyncStorage, More tab: lang-hi switches UI to Devanagari, power-save-toggle works, switch-role returns to picker. Volunteer: task accept flow persisted server-side (all 3 seeded tasks now show task-accepted-<id>), inventory +/- works, incident-submit works, team-chat reachable via more-team-chat. No deprecated Expo packages detected. Only console noise is 'shadow* style props are deprecated' on web (RN-web only).

minor.issue: No cleanup/reset endpoint; seeded RescueTask rows are mutated by PATCH tests across iterations (all 3 seed tasks now Accepted). Consider a POST /api/tasks or admin-only reset for repeatable testing.

issues: Uses RN shadowColor/shadowOpacity/shadowRadius which emit 'shadow* deprecated, use boxShadow' warnings when rendered on web. Cosmetic only; safe to migrate to boxShadow for web parity.

action_items: Optional: migrate shadowColor/Opacity/Radius on survivor/index.tsx (SOS button) to boxShadow to silence RN-web deprecation warning.

Optional: add a lightweight test-only reset or POST /api/tasks endpoint so seeded RescueTasks can be replenished; otherwise the accept/decline UI cannot be re-exercised on the same DB without manual re-seed.
Backend server.py currently reads MONGO_URL/DB_NAME via os.environ[...] (fail-fast) — good; keep as-is.
critical_code_review_comments: src/api/client.ts uses process.env.EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL directly — correct per Expo web contract.
AppStore.tsx: acceptTask/declineTask persist to AsyncStorage (accepted/declined id lists) and queue backend PATCH; correct offline-first pattern.
changeInventory is local-only (documented TODO). Backend has no PATCH /inventory/:id — expected.
captureCoords falls back to Delhi (28.6139, 77.209) on web where expo-location permission is unavailable; verified no crash.

MessagesView renders delivered/queued via icons only (checkmark-done vs time-outline). Not a bug, but automated text-based assertions won't see status; consider adding testID like msg-status-<id> for future testing.
seed_data_creation: Created multiple TEST_* records via POSTs and PATCH'd all 3 seeded RescueTasks to Accepted across iterations 1-3. No cleanup endpoint exists.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Public URL used (EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL). Local storage was cleared per test to reach role picker. All seeded tasks in Mongo are Accepted; accept-<id>/decline-<id> buttons will not render again unless main agent adds a task reset endpoint or POSTs a fresh task. Use page.goto to /survivor/<screen> or /volunteer/<screen> to bypass tab bar (Expo Router Tabs component doesn't emit tab-<name> testIDs). React DevTools + shadow* deprecation warnings on web are cosmetic.
rca_of_issue: No new blocking issues. Prior 'accept-<id> not found' during initial run was because seed tasks were already Accepted from cumulative iterations; confirmed by direct GET /api/tasks showing status=Accepted for all 3 IDs, and by inspecting DOM which contained task-accepted-<id> for each. Recommend a reset endpoint (see action items) if repeat UI-level accept testing is required.
